Multi-Device Gyroscope Synchronization: Start to End Marks

3D Resultant Angular Velocity (G_res = √[Gx²+Gy²+Gz²]) | Loadcell vs. Noraxon vs. Novel

Sync State:
Layout:
Jump To:
Time Window Slider (Pan Across Full Recording): Viewing: 0.0 s to 320.0 s (Full)
1. Common 90° Start Anchor (~10–13 s)

Deliberate vertical handle rotation from horizontal (0°) up to 90° and back. Generates a sharp >300 deg/s angular velocity peak across all 3 devices, establishing initial clock alignment.

2. Steady Continuous Rowing Window

5 minutes of continuous rowing at fixed 20 SPM. Every stroke displays identical rotational peaks at Catch turnaround (~10%) and Finish wrist feathering (~70%), confirming zero cumulative phase distortion.

3. Terminal End 90° Anchor (~310–322 s)

Final vertical 90° rotation mark before stopping. Validates clock drift closure (+103.3 ppm linear fit), leaving a residual alignment error of <0.52 ms across the entire 5-minute trial.
